title: Structural typing and duck typing patterns — concept map
intro: Duck typing, shape checks, branding patterns, nominal versus structural typing, and how JavaScript patterns foreshadow TypeScript interfaces.

conceptCards.title: Duck typing and shape-based APIs
conceptCards.summary: Compatibility by behavior at property access — thenables, array-likes, and why instanceof fails cross-realm.

conceptCards.title: Runtime validation: typeof guards and schema libraries
conceptCards.summary: Validate JSON and webhooks at trust boundaries — typeof guards, Zod safeParse, undefined vs null defaults.

conceptCards.title: Branding with Symbol and opaque types in JS
conceptCards.summary: TS phantom brands erase at runtime; secret Symbol factories prevent forged validated wrappers until JSON strips them.
conceptCards.example: type UserId = string & { readonly __brand: unique symbol }

conceptCards.title: Nominal (C#) versus structural (JS/TS) typing
conceptCards.summary: C# rejects same-shaped unrelated types; TS/JS accept shape — recover intent with brands and discriminated unions.
conceptCards.example: MetricPoint vs ScreenPoint — CS0029 in C#, fine in JS

conceptCards.title: Factory, builder, and object composition patterns
conceptCards.summary: createX(options) validates once, clones nested defaults, and composes behavior without deep class hierarchies.
conceptCards.example: createHttpClient({ baseUrl, timeout }) with frozen DEFAULTS
